definitions.explanation: A diagram or figure used to visually explain a concept, process, structure, or procedure.

examples.japanese: {説明図|せつめいず}を{見|み}てください。
examples.english: Please look at the explanatory diagram.

examples.japanese: {取扱|とりあつかい}{説明書|せつめいしょ}に{説明図|せつめいず}が{載|の}っている。
examples.english: There is an explanatory diagram in the instruction manual.

examples.japanese: {複雑|ふくざつ}な{仕組|しく}みを{説明図|せつめいず}を{使|つか}って{分|わ}かりやすく{解説|かいせつ}した。
examples.english: A complex mechanism was explained clearly using an explanatory diagram.

notes:
A compound of {説明|せつめい} (explanation) and {図|ず} (diagram; figure). Used in technical writing, manuals, textbooks, and presentations to refer to visual aids that clarify information.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {説明図|せつめいず}を{参照|さんしょう}する: to refer to the explanatory diagram
- {説明図|せつめいず}を{作成|さくせい}する: to create an explanatory diagram
- {説明図|せつめいず}{付|つ}き: with explanatory diagrams

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {図解|ずかい}: illustrated explanation — emphasizes the act of explaining through diagrams
- {模式図|もしきず}: schematic diagram — a simplified, abstract representation
- イラスト: illustration — broader term, includes decorative art as well as explanatory graphics
